dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Linear to slightly concave trailing edge spline extending from the posterior dorsal ridge to the fin apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded shape classification with a moderate pixel radius at the fin's highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree convex slope relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.1:1 ratio of maximum base width to maximum vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth convex arc with a large radius across the anterior-dorsal cranial boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short beak length with a high thickness-to-length pixel ratio extending from the melon inflection point.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Distinct obtuse interior angle where the melon slope transitions into the dorsal rostrum.

other_distinctive_markers: Broad, light-toned longitudinal band on the lateral surface; visible polygonal edge artifacts along the dorsal and ventral body contours.
